rubric.role_summary: Hands-on commercial electric-bicycle fleet service technician responsible for assembly, maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, software updates, and fleet readiness in a Seattle facility.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Hands-on commercial electric-bicycle fleet service technician responsible for assembly, maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, software updates, and fleet readiness in a Seattle facility.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- High school diploma or equivalent.
- 5+ years of hands-on experience in bicycle, e-bike, or EV/automotive maintenance and service.
- Skilled with hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Technical or vocational training in automotive, EV, or related fields.
- Experience with CAN bus diagnostics and fault-code troubleshooting.
- Experience with electronic control units (ECUs), flashing procedures, and diagnostic tools.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Seattle area, Washington. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas. Explicit work-attendance terms (city labels use the area interpretation above): This position is based in Seattle, Washington and requires in-person work at our facility five days per week.
